readme_excerpt: wifit3 > A standalone USB Wi-Fi auditor for Linux, Windows, and macOS. > At least one of the supported USB adapters is required. Why? Cross-Platform: Runs identically on Linux, macOS, and Windows. Wireless Driver Heaven: Built-in wireless stack avoids kernel driver versioning hell and Windows' NDIS. Zero Runtime Dependencies: No aircrack-ng or reaver, just pure Python with PyUSB & Textual libraries.
